text:
sam: heads-up from today's load replay — when host-stage fires we see a very short (1-6s) p99 tail caused by synchronous demotes + many tiny compactions. looks like allocator handoff + compactor scheduling is the hot path.

mira: can you summarize the sequence you observed? which component is the real bottleneck?

sam: sequence: staging trigger -> immediate best-effort demote attempts from several tenants -> compaction queue fills -> compactor workers pick many small ranges (high overhead per job) -> compaction latency piles up -> request latency p99 blips. bottleneck is compaction startup overhead + demote fanout.

jun: two axes to explore: (1) admission (rate/credits) for elective demotes, (2) coalescing/aggregation in compaction scheduler. i sketched a hybrid: soft admission + opportunistic coalesce window.

pavel: sketch of admission signal: compute `evict_pressure = smooth(queue_len, 1s) * (1 + max(0, -d(resident_score)))`. map to `demote_capacity = floor(sigmoid((evict_pressure - t)/s) * cap)` where t=6, s=3, cap=12. that gives a continuous knob.

sam: plus per-tenant soft credits (size-weighted) so a single tenant can't exhaust the host's elective demotes in a short burst. credits replenish on a sliding 60s window.

jun: compaction side: collect demote intents for a coalesce_window (50-150ms). if ranges are adjacent or same page stripe, merge into a single job. otherwise prefer aggregating small ranges into a batched job that yields sub-range readiness as it flushes. reduces worker overhead.

mira: safety: must bypass admission if host is near-OOM. propose `if free_pages_pct < 4%: emergency_demote()` — bypass everything. also cooldown to avoid flip-flopping.

pavel: operational telemetry before canary: `evict_pressure`, `demote_capacity`, `credits_used_by_tenant`, `compactions_coalesced`, `compactions_inflight`, `demote_denied.count`, `p99_while_demote_active`. add decision logs with context.

sam: sample config we tested locally:
```
admission:
  smoothing_ms: 1000
  threshold: 6.0
  scale: 3.0
  max_demotes_host: 12
credits:
  window_s: 60
  size_per_credit_bytes: 65536
  default_tenant_credits: 4
coalesce:
  window_ms: 100
  max_merge_bytes: 1MB
safety:
  emergency_free_pct: 4.0
  cooldown_s: 5
```

jun: local sim results: p99 for small-batch workloads down ~25%, compaction job count down ~32%, no OOMs in 2h runs.

mira: rollout plan: feature flag off by default -> QA cluster canary (all QA hosts) -> prod pilot (5 hosts) -> monitor 24h windows for p50/p95/p99, demote_denied, emergency_demote alerts -> expand. include immediate kill-switch.

sam: failure modes: misconfigured credit_size starving tenants; sigmoid scale too aggressive causing slow reaction. add unit tests for mapping boundaries and an integration replay test with staging signal. also add an alert: `emergency_demote > 2 in 5m`.

ops-bot: note: host-11 reported free_pages_pct=3.7% emergency_demote invoked p95=480ms

mira: good that emergency bypass works. @sam please open the PR with config, metrics, and a concise SRE playbook (how to toggle, expected dashboards, rollback steps). @jun please add deterministic coalesce tests. i'll review the telemetry. :thumbsup:

sam: will do. tagging @pavel for sigmoid parameter sanity-check. thanks all.
